Method of Attack: URL spoofing attacks by exploiting an address bar spoofing vulnerability using a specially crafted JavaScript page with setInterval function to reload URL every 10 to 50 ms, modifying inner HTML to display different content
Attack Vector: Address bar spoofing vulnerability in the browser's omnibar
Indicators of Compromise: spoofed URL displayed in address bar, malicious JavaScript page, camouflaged domains mimicking high-profile websites, phishing landing pages, malvertising campaigns
